goal: Read Codex memory stores as scoped recall corpora
asset: Derived recall index and session context
scope: Codex leaf heading passages and rollout provenance (#164)
cwd and configured peer alias scoping
outOfScope: Serving unscoped cross-project aggregate memories by default

record.question: How should recall discover local knowledge and refresh without blocking hooks or sending documents unexpectedly?

options.strongest_objection: Source discovery and concurrent cache publication need clear bounds and regression tests
Auto-updates discard local source and refresh customizations
Adds lifecycle and authentication work beyond source discovery and reliable refresh

record.rationale: Keep sources read-only, make corpus roots explicit and derive a fresh atomic cache; hooks launch detached keyless rebuilds.
evidence: Open issue reproductions #147-152 #159 #161 #163 and current source inspection

costs.cost: Maintain a bounded Markdown reader, configuration validation and atomic derived cache writes
evidence: Existing recall lexical retrieval and workfile_lock cover ranking and serialized publication

costs.cost: Every plugin update requires reapplying local edits and risks silently dropping context
evidence: Issue #152 documents cache version replacement behavior

costs.cost: Add process lifetime, client framing, authentication and invalidation protocols
evidence: Issue #153 requests warm queries; no deployment or benchmark evidence yet

requirements.statement: Discover Codex memory and preserve scoped heading, thread and timestamp metadata without serving another project's rollout or aggregate section
requirements.counterexample: A rollout for another cwd enters this project index, or MEMORY.md is skipped despite a matching project section

checks.scope: Controlled Codex stores exercise discovery, leaf passages, aliases, provenance and refresh fingerprints
assumptions: cwd metadata and configured aliases truthfully identify source project

challenges.claim: Does a detached rebuild or configured corpus authorize document embeddings?
challenges.resolution: No. Refresh and ordinary queries rebuild keyless; explicit build --embed is required for document backfill, and external notes require explicit FPL_EMBEDDER selection.
